Title: Lily + Claude Code — Lily Design System

Description: Claude Skills 30 suna ba Claude Code ingantacciyar hanyar shiga mai iya ɗorawa zuwa Lily Design System — ra’ayoyin gama-gari, ƙwarewar laima ta kowane tsarin aiki, da zurfin ƙwarewa ta kowane ƙaramin aiki don ɗakin karatu marar kai da masu taimakon *-picker.

# Ƙwarewa a kan wakilan AI suna sa Lily ta fi sauƙi

Lily tana kawo ƙwarewa mai mayar da hankali — ta gama-gari, ta kowane tsarin aiki, da ta kowane ƙaramin aiki — don wakili ya ɗora daidai mahallin da yake buƙata kuma babu abin da ba ya buƙata.

## Wace ƙwarewa kake so?

Kowane mataki yana amsa tambaya daban. Ɗora ƙwarewar gama-gari idan ba ka san Lily ba tukuna. Ɗora ƙwarewar tsarin aiki idan ka san tsarin aikinka amma ba ka san wane ƙaramin aiki kake buƙata ba. Ɗora headless-skill ko helpers-skill kai tsaye idan ka riga ka san ainihin abin da kake aiki a kai.

- **Gama-gari / mai kulawa** — “Menene Lily?” / “Yaya aka gina wannan monorepo?” — [`lily-design-system-skill`](https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem/lily-design-system/tree/main/lily-design-system-skill), [`lily-design-system-maintainer-skill`](https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem/lily-design-system/tree/main/lily-design-system-maintainer-skill)
- **Laimar tsarin aiki** — “Me ke akwai don {framework}, kuma wane ɓangare nake buƙata?” — 8, `{framework}-skill` ɗaya kowanne
- **Marar kai / masu taimako** — “Ta yaya zan yi amfani da abubuwan / masu taimakon *-picker na {framework} daidai?” — 16, `{framework}-headless-skill` ɗaya da `{framework}-helpers-skill` ɗaya kowanne

## Tsarin aiki takwas

Kowane tsarin aiki yana samun tarin matakai uku iri ɗaya. Ƙwarewar laima tana tsara dukkan ainihin ƙananan ayyukan wannan tsarin aiki — har da aikace-aikacen misali, wanda babu ɗaya daga cikin ƙwarewar ’yan uwanta biyu da ke rufewa — kuma tana nuna ƙasa gare su maimakon maimaita yarjejeniyoyinsu.

## Ƙara ƙwarewa ɗaya

Kowace ƙwarewa fayil ce ta [`SKILL.md`](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) — tare da fayilolin tallafi, babu matakin gini. Kwafa wacce kake buƙata zuwa duk inda saitin Claude Code ɗinka ke ɗora ƙwarewa (duba takardun hukuma da aka haɗa a sama don kundin ƙwarewa na aikinka ko asusunka):

```
git clone https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem/lily-design-system
cd lily-design-system/lily-design-system-svelte-skill
```

Kana aiki a kan tsarin aiki da yawa, ko a kan monorepo da kansa? Kwafa [monorepo na ƙa’ida](https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem/lily-design-system) maimakon haka — dukkan ƙwarewa 30 sun riga sun kasance a tushensa, kusa da ɗakunan karatu marasa kai, jerin masu taimako da aikace-aikacen misali da suke bayyanawa.
